summary: Iteration 2 testing: register endpoint, chart, monthly reports, public receipts, multi-tenant scoping, rebrand and new UI (register page, remind, monthly report dialog, cash flow chart, public receipt page). 13/13 backend tests passing (pytest). All backend endpoints work as specified. Frontend: rebrand OK, go-register OK, register validations + redirect OK, dashboard business_name OK, open-report-btn + report-dialog + report-download-btn OK, cash-flow-chart OK, public receipt page /r/{token} works perfectly with no auth (copy link + baixar PDF buttons present, business name + client + amount rendered), bad token shows receipt-error. Found one integration bug (see action_items) and applied one small backend fix (Installment Pydantic model missing receipt_token field, which broke frontend consumption).

integration_issues.flow: PaymentDialog receipt buttons after successful payment
integration_issues.issue: Dashboard.jsx onSaved handler calls setPaymentCtx(null) immediately after a successful payment, which unmounts PaymentDialog before it can render pd-copy-receipt / pd-open-receipt. As implemented, users never see the 'Copiar recibo' / 'Abrir recibo' buttons on the payment dialog from the Dashboard row flow. The receiptToken state inside PaymentDialog is set correctly but the parent forcibly closes the dialog. Fix: onSaved should NOT close the dialog (or only close on explicit user action). Change Dashboard.jsx line 589-592 to just call load() without setPaymentCtx(null); let PaymentDialog stay open until user clicks 'Fechar' (pd-close).

issues: Recharts warning: width/height (-1) - container measurement race on first render. Chart still renders on subsequent frame. Consider adding minWidth/minHeight or explicit height to the ResponsiveContainer wrapper.

action_items: Dashboard.jsx onSaved for PaymentDialog: remove setPaymentCtx(null) so the receipt buttons (pd-copy-receipt / pd-open-receipt) become visible after a successful payment. Currently the dialog closes immediately and users cannot access those buttons from the row 'Pagar' flow. The receipt buttons in ClientDetailSheet (copy-receipt-{n} / open-receipt-{n}) were not exercised in UI but the same underlying data is now present since backend fix is applied.
critical_code_review_comments: SERIALIZATION BUG (fixed by test agent): Pydantic Installment model in /app/backend/server.py did not declare `receipt_token`, so it was stripped from every ClientOut response (POST /clients/{id}/payments, GET /clients/{id}, GET /clients). Frontend PaymentDialog and ClientDetailSheet rely on this field. Added `receipt_token: Optional[str] = None`.
Dashboard onSaved handler prematurely closes PaymentDialog so the newly-added receipt buttons never render (see integration_issues).
Public receipt endpoint is well-scoped (no auth dep) and correctly returns owner business_name.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first render; consider explicit height.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of receipt-buttons regression: Dashboard.jsx (line ~589) sets paymentCtx=null on onSaved, which triggers PaymentDialog `if (!ctx) return null` early-return, unmounting the receipt-buttons branch. Compounded initially by backend Installment Pydantic model stripping receipt_token (fixed). Reproduction: click Pagar → submit dialog → observe toast 'Pagamento registrado' → dialog closes → no receipt buttons visible. Mitigation: keep dialog mounted in success state (do not null paymentCtx in onSaved) and let user close via pd-close button or explicit onOpenChange.
